title: Z9.F local array — Injectivity of the complete actual pole-coefficient array
milestone_description: For every natural $n$, restrict rational polynomials $W$ to $2n+2\deg W<9(n+1)$ and send them to the complete array of actual formal-jet coefficients $$(c^W_{n,j,s})_{0\le j\le n,\ 1\le s\le9}.$$ This map is injective: two multipliers in that domain with identical complete arrays are equal. Every coefficient is taken from the genuine shifted-product formal quotient, not abstract data. No surjectivity, inverse of the original five-dimensional aggregate F, or exact infinite L-sum is claimed.
